Microsoft seizes 50 sites behind phishing kit that took 12,000 inboxes

Microsoft said EvilTokens sold device-code phishing for $1,500 and a $500 monthly fee, and that about 1,000 criminals used it before the takedown.

https://theaipost.net/story/eviltokens-takedown/

Alibaba launches Qwen Intelligence, says its 3 phone agents run on Honor

The company put end-to-end task completion at 90% and said its planner agent tops MobilePA-Bench, a benchmark suite Alibaba wrote and published itself.

https://theaipost.net/story/qwen-intelligence-honor/

Qualcomm to buy PickNik Robotics, says MoveIt stays open source

The company said it will keep MoveIt 1 and 2 under their existing licence and fold PickNik's commercial MoveIt Pro into its Dragonwing platform. Terms were not disclosed.

https://theaipost.net/story/qualcomm-picknik-moveit/

UK regulator would put AI assistants on Google's choice screens

The Competition and Markets Authority proposed that assistants meeting Google's technical and security criteria sit alongside search engines, with consultation open until 9 October.

https://theaipost.net/story/cma-google-choice-screens-ai/

Developers fill X with games they say Opus 5.5 built in one prompt

A Roblox fighter, browser Minecraft clones and a guitar-shop simulator drew thousands of likes within a day, though two builders said their demos are unfinished.

https://theaipost.net/story/opus55-one-shot-games/

Engineer says Opus 5.5 wrote a GPU kernel at 35.5 times PyTorch

Elliot Arledge published a run-by-run comparison on his own hardware and put GPT-6 Astra second at 24.8 times the baseline.

https://theaipost.net/story/opus55-kernelbench-arledge/

Sanders bill would ban superintelligence, create Department of AI

The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act would pause advanced AI work until a new federal regulator writes safety rules, and carries prison terms of up to 20 years.

https://theaipost.net/story/sanders-casar-superintelligence-ban/

Tekever closes first tranche of 500 million euro round at 5.5 billion value

The Portuguese drone maker is hunting acquisitions after the first close, and its chief executive said a listing is on the horizon.

https://theaipost.net/story/tekever-500m-first-close/

Samsung says it validated 16GB LPDDR6 on Qualcomm's next flagship chip

The memory ran at 10.7 gigabits per second on Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, Seoul Economic Daily said, citing industry sources.

https://theaipost.net/story/samsung-lpddr6-snapdragon-validation/

Alibaba releases 5 Qwen audio models, cuts speech recognition price

Qwen said the upgrade covers recognition, synthesis and realtime conversation, adds two models, and cuts prices by up to 95%.

https://theaipost.net/story/qwen-audio-31/

Firmus in talks over $10 billion for Indonesian data centre, Bloomberg says

The Australian company is negotiating with lenders on a financing deal to buy Nvidia chips, Bloomberg reported. Firmus has not commented publicly.

https://theaipost.net/story/firmus-10bn-indonesia/

Samsung renames next DRAM node around wafer bonding, ZDNet Korea says

D0a now refers to the B1b hybrid-bonding process, while the vertical-transistor design that carried the name becomes D0a-V, according to the report.

https://theaipost.net/story/samsung-d0a-b1b-hybrid-bonding/

China surveys Broadcom switch use in state data centres, FT says

Beijing's state-assets regulator counted the switches in state-controlled facilities and could issue informal guidance to cut their use, according to the Financial Times.

https://theaipost.net/story/sasac-broadcom-switch-survey/

Vals AI puts GPT-6 Sol 8th on its index at half the cost

The evaluator said the model scores about level with GPT-5.6 Sol while OpenAI has halved its per-token price, and that it slips on finance, tax and law.

https://theaipost.net/story/valsai-gpt6-sol-index/

Taiwan export orders reach $102.96 billion in August, ministry says

Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs put August export orders 71.4 percent above a year earlier, the first month above $100 billion.

https://theaipost.net/story/taiwan-august-export-orders/

Carnegie report traces 57% of elite AI researchers to Chinese degrees

The share of top AI researchers who took an undergraduate degree in China rose from 27 percent in 2022, the report says.

https://theaipost.net/story/carnegie-ai-talent-race/

Anthropic in talks for 1 gigawatt of Apollo-backed compute, report says

The Information reported early talks to lease capacity from Stream, a data centre developer majority-owned by Apollo Global Management.

https://theaipost.net/story/anthropic-stream-apollo-talks/

Alibaba to open first cloud regions in Turkey, Finland and Netherlands

Bloomberg reported the three sites will open within 12 months, as part of a global buildout Alibaba puts at 20 gigawatts.

https://theaipost.net/story/alibaba-europe-cloud-regions/

Vals AI puts Xiaomi's MiMo v2.6 Pro and Flash top of open-weight index

The evaluator priced the two models at $0.39 and $0.20 per task, against $6.47 for Kimi K3, and said both sit on its cost frontier.

https://theaipost.net/story/valsai-mimo-v26-index-top/

Microsoft plans Copilot discounts of up to 50%, The Information says

Four market accounts relayed the report within minutes of each other on Tuesday, and they differ on the size of the cut.

https://theaipost.net/story/msft-copilot-discounts/

Artificial Analysis puts Opus 5.5 at $5.98 per task, near Opus 5

The evaluator said a 20% price cut and cheaper cache reads offset a token-usage increase that would otherwise have pushed the figure to $10.51.

https://theaipost.net/story/aa-cost-per-task-opus55-gpt6/

OpenAI adds cache breakpoints and prewarming to GPT-6 prompt caching

The company said the changes raise hit rates and cut latency, and that reasoning changes no longer throw away a cached prefix.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-gpt6-prompt-caching/

Rabbit releases cloud agent that runs without its R1 device

The company said OS3 runs in the cloud but acts locally on Windows, Mac and Linux machines, and Wired had the story first.

https://theaipost.net/story/rabbit-os3-standalone/

Vals AI scores Ant Group's Ling 3.0 Flash Fin at 54.9% on finance test

The evaluator put the model fourth among open-weight entries and said it costs $0.045 per task, the cheapest in the top 20.

https://theaipost.net/story/valsai-ling-30-flash-fin/
